newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIA confirms talks with AUA.
newsitem.headline: SIA confirms talks with AUA.

text.p: Singapore Airlines (SIA) confirmed on Tuesday it was holding talks with Austrian Airlines Oesterreichische Luftverkehrs AG on unspecified "commercial matters".
"I confirm that we have been having talks with Austrian Airlines on commercial matters," SIA spokesman Rick Clements told Reuters.
Austrian Airlines confirmed earlier in the day it was in cooperation talks with SIA and hoped to strike a deal before the start of the winter timetable at the end of October.
A spokesman said the Austrian carrier had earlier conducted parallel talks with Malaysian Airlines but had made more progress with Singapore Airlines.
Vienna daily Die Presse said the pact with AIA would include a code sharing deal on the Vienna-Singapore route.
